author: tomqss
body:
Hello there, 

I noticed lately that there was no good place to look for an Avicus scrimmage since every chat is ruined by spammers that got away with it with no punishment. To avoid this my chat will have its own rules. It will also have some moderators.

To be added to the chat you can ask anybody who already is in it. My skype is on my profile if you want me to add you (please tell me that you add me for this so I can instantly add you).

Current Moderators in it:
- Acceqted
- Jahaj
- Junr
- Tomqss
